data.define: Slang for food that tastes amazing.

misuse.text: Don't say 'bussin' about a cold, bland sandwich.

data.l1_hook: Annemin makarnası bu gece inanılmaz lezzetli!

native.tip: “bussin” = nefis. Örnek: “Mom's pasta is bussin tonight.”
